# Daniela Cruz — Director of Development

- **Relationship:** direct report; leads fundraising. **Successor to
  [Gregory Lang](gregory-lang.md)**, who departed — she stepped up from Associate Director and has
  held the function together since.
- **Owns:** all fundraising — the [Hearthstone Foundation grant](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md)
  relationship, major-donor cultivation, and the [Annual Gala 2026](../projects/annual-gala-2026.md)
  campaign. Primary staff contact for foundation Program Officer [Diane Alcott](diane-alcott.md).
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Tuesdays; more often during gala season.

## What she cares about
- Reducing Keystone's dependence on any single funder after the Hearthstone decline.
- Filling the open **Development Associate** role (backfill for Gregory) — she's stretched thin.

## Notes
- Excellent with major donors; manages the sensitive relationships with
  [Sarah Whitman](sarah-whitman.md) and [Walter Brennan](walter-brennan.md).
- In the cleared circle for [Willow](../projects/willow.md).
